decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers remain close to the firm's core heat-transfer and air-cooling knowledge, so with its engineering base, service feedback, and in-house R&D the firm would more likely retain and refine the product than withdraw it.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit the firm's established thermal-engineering capabilities and are especially amenable to learning and improvement through its own R&D and research cooperation, making continued commercialization the more likely choice.
